idea-plugin.name: Tombstone Feature Flags
idea-plugin.description:
Tombstone integrates your IDE with the Tombstone feature flag platform.

  • Inline CodeLens showing live flag state (enabled/disabled, rollout %) directly above flag evaluation calls
  • Kill Switch action — disable any flag immediately from your editor without opening the dashboard
  • Natural-language flag search powered by Tombstone's NLP engine
  • Stale flag detection with one-click cleanup PR generation via ast-rewriter
  • Tool window showing all active flags, their blast-radius tier, and SLO status

Requires a running Tombstone instance (self-hosted via Docker Compose). See GitHub for setup.
